properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Storage Account: HTTPS Transfer Only
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Storage Accounts that allow non-HTTPS traffic. FedRAMP High requires transmission confidentiality (SC-8). All Storage Account data operations (blob, queue, table, file) must use HTTPS — HTTP access is prohibited to prevent cleartext data exposure.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Storage Accounts allowing HTTP. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
